def process(reportsByType2024) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = reportsByType2024.copy()

    # The file has a title row then the real header at row index 1.
    df = df.rename(
        columns={
            "Number of Reports by Type": "Year",
            "Unnamed: 1": "Fraud",
            "Unnamed: 2": "Identity Theft",
            "Unnamed: 3": "Other",
        }
    )

    # Keep only plausible year rows
    df = df[df["Year"].astype(str).str.fullmatch(r"\d{4}")].copy()
    df["Year"] = df["Year"].astype(int)

    for c in ["Fraud", "Identity Theft", "Other"]:
        df[c] = (
            df[c]
            .astype(str)
            .str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
            .str.strip()
        )
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    row2024 = df[df["Year"] == 2024].iloc[0]
    fraud = float(row2024["Fraud"])
    total = float(row2024[["Fraud", "Identity Theft", "Other"]].sum())

    pct = round(100.0 * fraud / total)
    return pd.DataFrame([{"year": 2024, "fraud": fraud, "total": total, "fraud_pct_int": int(pct)}])

operators.customDisplayName: Compute 2024 fraud reporter percentage from reportsByType2024: rename columns to [Year, Fraud, Identity Theft, Other]; keep rows where Year matches 4-digit year; parse counts by removing commas and converting to numeric; for Year=2024 compute total=Fraud+Identity Theft+Other and fraud_pct_int=round(100*Fraud/total); return single-row DataFrame with year, fraud, total, fraud_pct_int.
